lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information for the Pitcairn Islands. Data completeness was assessed using AI-mapped estimates, indicating approximately 100% coverage of 164 buildings. The dataset was compiled and published by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team with metadata on data currency (average 2 years old, last edited 4 months ago) and recent update frequency.
